name: DeepSeek Harness
author: FIELD NOTE
description: Service-grade control for the local DeepSeek Harness (dsh web) UI from the Omarchy bar: status, start/stop, logs, updates, proxy, and settings.

barWidget.description: Run and manage the local dsh web service: health, start/stop, logs, updates, proxy, and settings from one bar icon.

schema.label: Web port
schema.description: Listener port for dsh web. 0 lets the OS pick a free port.

schema.label: Proxy URL
schema.description: Optional HTTP(S) proxy for the background service and update checks, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:7890.

schema.label: dsh executable
schema.description: Optional absolute path to dsh. Leave empty to auto-detect mise, PATH, and ~/.local/bin.

schema.label: Start service on login
schema.description: Applied when the background service is installed or repaired.

schema.label: Nerd Font glyph
schema.description: Bar glyph. Use any Nerd Font symbol, or the letters DS for a plain label.
